spec:
# Hold notifications during a user's quiet hours

Add `planDelivery(prefs, notice, minuteOfDay)` to `src/quiet-hours.ts`, returning `{ deferred, deliverIn }`.

- `prefs` is `{ quiet: QuietWindow | null, bypass: readonly string[] }`, `notice` is `{ senderId, urgent }`, and
  `minuteOfDay` is the current minute of the day (0 to 1439). Export the `DeliveryPrefs`, `Notice` and
  `DeliveryPlan` types.
- A quiet window covers the minutes from `start` (included) up to `end` (excluded). If `start > end` the window
  runs past midnight: `{ start: 1320, end: 420 }` is 22:00 to 07:00. `start === end` means no quiet period at all.
- Outside quiet time, or with `quiet: null`, deliver now: `{ deferred: false, deliverIn: 0 }`.
- During quiet time, hold the notice until the window ends: `{ deferred: true, deliverIn: N }`, where N is the
  number of minutes from `minuteOfDay` forward to `end`, counting across midnight when needed (at 23:00 in the
  window above, N = 480).
- Exception: an urgent notice (`urgent: true`) from a sender listed in `prefs.bypass` is delivered now, even during
  quiet time. Non-urgent notices from those senders are still held, and so are urgent notices from anyone else.
- `minuteOfDay`, `quiet.start` and `quiet.end` must each pass `isValidMinute`; otherwise throw a `RangeError`.
intent:
Add `planDelivery(prefs, notice, minuteOfDay)` and the `DeliveryPrefs`, `Notice` and `DeliveryPlan` types to
`src/quiet-hours.ts`: decide whether a notice is held during a half-open quiet window that may cross midnight, how
many minutes until the window ends, when an urgent notice from a listed sender skips the hold, and validate every
minute with the existing `isValidMinute`. Keep `MINUTES_PER_DAY`, `QuietWindow` and `isValidMinute`.
